name: CallGlance
description:
Is your connection good enough for calls? A colored dot in the top bar, live latency, jitter and packet loss to your router, your ISP and the internet, a one-hour graph, and a desktop widget. Tells you whether your Wi-Fi or your ISP is to blame.

Needs the CallGlance app, which does the measuring: https://github.com/rafay-ah/callglance
